title: The Sea And Me
meta_description: Elegant coastal escape in Prominence South with porches, swings, king ensuites, bikes, and access to heated pools, The Big Chill, and scenic 30A beaches.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: This elegant coastal retreat offers modern finishes with an open floor plan, including a gourmet kitchen with a large island and breakfast bar, a hand-crafted dining table that seats ten, and a large living room space. There are two king rooms with ensuite bathrooms, one on each level. The upstairs king ensuite includes a private patio with a swinging daybed and rockers. Both the queen ensuite and a bunk room have private access to a porch. Outdoor entertaining areas can on the first level feature a screened-in porch, large porch swings and deck with plenty of room for grilling and dining al fresco.

\*\*\* PROMINENCE POOL NOW HEATED October \& November AND March \& April

ABOUT THE AREA: Prominence South is a charming coastal community nestled between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach and just 20 minutes to Pier Park. The community features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Residents will enjoy easy access to a beautiful town center, 5,000 square foot resort style pool. In the heart of Prominence is The Big Chill (formerly the Hub), a family hot spot for dining, shopping and entertainment, featuring an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which streams major sporting events, movies as well as features live music on their very own stage.

BEACH ACCESS: Deer Lake State Park: This state park is roughly 1/2 mile from Prominence. There is an entry fee of $3 per vehicle (2 to 8 passengers) or $2 per pedestrian, bicyclist, and extra passengers. There is a long scenic boardwalk that brings you from the parking lot to the beach and is a five-to-ten minute walk. Beach service is not provided here.

Walton Dunes: located 2.5 miles from the Prominence area, Walton Dunes is an easily accessible beach entrance! Unlike Deer Lake, there are no stairs/ramps and you can walk right up to the beach. You take a left at Lakewood Drive and follow the curve until you see the parking lot for cars/golf carts. Beach service is the only amenity provided.

Santa Clara: located 3.5 miles away and is ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located on Scenic 30A, 1/2 mile east of Scenic 395, turn south on Bramble Grove Place.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- 1 Queen, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- 2 Twin/Twin Bunks
• Sleeper Sofa

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Bikes
• 2 Community Pools
• Screened in porch with daybed swing
• Coffee Maker -- traditional and pod
• Grill -- Propane
• Smart TVs
• Full linen package: bedding, bath towels
• Starter kit: hand soap, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces with overflow parking available south-side gravel area.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
